entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
2.

In the present case, the petitioner seeks bail in connection with Sheikhpurs P.S. Case No. 163 of 2022 registered on 04.04.2022 for the alleged offences under Sections 467, 468, 471, 419, 420 and 414 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. As per prosecution case, police apprehended four co- accused persons on suspicion and recovered some ATM cards, mobile phones and cash.
On further investigation the apprehended co-accused persons confessed that they were involved in cyber cheating and named other co-accused persons who were also involved in the illegal activities.
At the instance of these co- accused persons further raids were conducted at the houses of different co-accused persons and some incriminating articles were recovered.

The name of the petitioner came up in the disclosure of Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.25642 of 2023(2) dt.19-05-2023 these apprehended co-accused persons who stated that the petitioner was the king-pin.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
Petitioner was not present at the spot from where other co-accused persons were apprehended.
Nothing incriminating has been recovered from the possession of this petitioner.
There is no victim who might have come forward to say that they have been cheated by the petitioner and other co-accused persons.

A number of co- accused persons have been granted bail by this Hon'ble High Court passed in Cr. Misc. Nos. 29248 of 2022, 29816 of 2022, 31779 of 2022,

entities.text: Paras Kumar @ Shukla vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The case of the petitioner is on better footing.
The petitioner is in custody since 07.02.2023 Charge-sheet has been submitted.
The petitioner is having clean antecedent.

5. Learned APP opposes the prayer for bail submitting that petitioner and other co-accused persons are involved in cyber cheating and they induced the innocent people by sending messages to pay money on some false pretext.

6. Having regard to the facts and circumstances and submissions made on behalf of the parties and considering the fact that nothing substantive material has come up on record to connect Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.25642 of 2023(2) dt.19-05-2023

the petitioner with the offence as alleged in the FIR and further considering the clean antecedent of the petitioner along with his period of custody and submission of charge-sheet, the petitioner above named is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 20,000/- (twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sheikhpura/concerned court in connection with Sheikhpura P.S. Case No. 163 of 2022, subject to the conditions mentioned in Section 437(3) of the Code of Criminal Procedure and also the following conditions :
(i) One of the bailors will be a close relative of the petitioner.
(ii) The petitioner will remain present on each and every date fixed by the court below.
(iii) In case of absence on three consecutive dates or in violation of the terms of the bail, the bail bonds of the petitioner will be liable to be cancelled by the court concerned.

(Arun Kumar Jha, J) balmukund/-
